HeliBoard 4.0 English keyboard
================================

Purpose
-------
MIBU installs this keyboard only when the connected phone has no verified
English-capable input method. MIBU verifies the package and input-method
service before selecting it or disabling Xiaomi's Sogou keyboard.

Upstream
--------
Project: https://github.com/HeliBorg/HeliBoard
Release tag: v4.0
Source commit: bd48798b99cccc99704eebf2a9259c02dbd684d5
Build variant: debugNoMinify
Application ID: helium314.keyboard.debug
IME service: helium314.keyboard.latin.LatinIME
Native ABI: arm64-v8a
